name: uilepheist
text: uilepheist is the Scottish Gaelic counterpart of the oilliphéist, the Celtic water-monster. MacKillop reads the form as a direct Scottish-Gaelic equivalent. The principal record of the water-monster tradition sits under the oilliphéist headword.

attributes.attribute: Scottish Gaelic form of the oilliphéist water-monster

okr.objective: uilepheist is a MacKillop signpost to oilliphéist.
key_results: Cites oilliphéist as the canonical headword.
